cream-hover.note: Literal value reused in styles.css; not a custom property.

paper-sheet.note: Literal value reused in styles.css; not a custom property.

paper-field.note: Literal value reused in styles.css; not a custom property.

pine-hover.note: Literal value reused in styles.css; not a custom property.

pine-tint-edge.note: Literal value reused in styles.css; not a custom property.

blaze-hover.note: Literal value reused in styles.css; not a custom property.

display.purpose: The date on the hero board; the largest thing on the site, used once.

headline.purpose: h2 and inner-page h1 (.page-title), almost always wrapped in a plank.

plank.purpose: Heading text inside a plank; slightly smaller than a bare headline because the wood adds weight.

title.purpose: h3 and .h3: notice headings, lodging group headings.

body.purpose: Atkinson Hyperlegible prose at 18.9px on an 18px root, capped at 66ch.

label.purpose: Fact keys, field labels, plaque and chip text, nav links. Never uppercased or tracked.

mono.purpose: The GPS coordinates code block only.

shadows.name: shadow-1
shadows.purpose: Sheet lift: the last-mile map figure resting on the paper.

shadows.name: shadow-2
shadows.purpose: Board lift: the routed board, with its inset frame lines.

shadows.name: board-frame
shadows.purpose: The routed frame of the board, combined with shadow-2.

shadows.name: plank-frame
shadows.purpose: Plank headings; pine plank uses --pine-deep and #38704a. No drop shadow.

shadows.name: plaque-rest
shadows.purpose: Every plaque at rest; pine plaques swap the base to --pine-deep.

shadows.name: kiosk-edge-header
shadows.purpose: Sticky header meeting the paper; the action bar mirrors it upward.

shadows.name: route-step
shadows.purpose: Numbered pine badge on directions steps.

shadows.name: focus-paper
shadows.value: outline: 3px solid var(--blaze); outline-offset: 3px; box-shadow: 0 0 0 7px var(--paper)

shadows.name: focus-board
shadows.value: outline: 3px solid var(--cream); outline-offset: 3px; box-shadow: 0 0 0 7px var(--board)
shadows.purpose: Focus ring on board surfaces (header, footer, board, action bar).

motion.name: ease
motion.purpose: The one curve for every transition and animation.

motion.name: press
motion.purpose: Plaque and chip transform and shadow on press.

motion.name: field-focus
motion.purpose: Field border and shadow on focus.

motion.name: fill
motion.purpose: Background-color changes on plaques and chips; the skip link drop-in.

motion.name: menu-in
motion.purpose: Mobile nav list entrance (opacity, -6px rise); FAQ icon rotation.

motion.name: action-bar
motion.purpose: Phone action bar sliding up from translateY(110%).

motion.name: reveal
motion.purpose: Scroll reveal: 14px rise, once, with a 2.5s failsafe that shows everything.

motion.name: route-in
motion.purpose: Hero letters wipe in via clip-path inset, staggered 0.12s to 0.7s.

motion.name: draw
motion.purpose: Last-mile map path draws itself when 30% visible.

motion.name: drift
motion.purpose: Ridge leaves; only while the ridge is on screen and the tab is visible.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: prefers-reduced-motion: smooth scroll off; cut, reveal, draw, leaves, mist, bar, plaque, chip, FAQ transitions set to none; state changes remain.

breakpoints.name: compact-header
breakpoints.purpose: Wordmark 1.15rem, icon 1.7rem, header 3.9rem, tighter menu toggle.

breakpoints.name: facts-two-col
breakpoints.purpose: Fact rows become an 11rem key column plus value.

breakpoints.name: stay-two-col
breakpoints.purpose: Lodging rows pin the call plaques to the right.

breakpoints.name: desktop
breakpoints.purpose: Inline nav, wider board padding, 4rem sections, two-column summaries and life page, ridge overlap 5.5rem, action bar hidden.

assets.ridge: assets/ridge.jpg 1600x560 and ridge@2x.jpg (painted October ridge, the single ground picture)
assets.icons: inline 24-unit stroke SVGs, stroke 2 to 2.4, round caps, aria-hidden

components.description: Numbered driving steps with a pine circle badge; the last-mile grammar.
components.html:

  3. Turn left immediately after the bridge onto East River Road.

components.html:
When and where, once more?

Saturday, October 10, 2026, beginning at 11:00 AM, at the picnic shelter in Peoples State Forest.

Is it outdoors? What if it rains?

Yes. The shelter has a roof, so we gather rain or shine.

narrative.overview:
The site is the trailhead kiosk a visitor walks past on the day: a routed pine board with cream letters cut into it, saying when and where before anything else, with a sheet of notice paper pinned under the plexiglass for everything that needs reading. It refuses the memorial template of a cream page, a soft portrait, and a candle. The board is dark, sturdy, and warm; the paper is pale and quiet; the only working colors are the pine green of the trail blaze and the blaze orange of the arrow that says go this way.

Density is low and the type is large because the audience is family and friends in their sixties to eighties, on phones, often grieving. Every fact sits in a ruled row or a plank-headed section; every action is a plaque you can press with a thumb. Motion exists (letters route in, leaves drift down the ridge, the last-mile map draws itself) but it is slow, one-shot, and stops entirely under reduced motion without hiding anything. The voice of the visuals matches the voice of the copy: plain, warm, never cheerful, never urgent.
keyCharacteristics: One dark routed board per page carries the headline facts; everything else reads on notice paper.
Two working colors only: pine for wayfinding and section variants, blaze for the single primary action in view.
Rubik at 700 to 800 for anything routed or labelled; Atkinson Hyperlegible for prose, never below 18px.
Plaques are the only element that lifts and presses; planks, notices, and rows sit flush.
Inline stroke icons (arrow, pin, calendar, phone, car, plus) are the wayfinding grammar; no icon fonts, no emoji.
Motion is authored once per element, uses one ease, and is fully removed under `prefers-reduced-motion`.

rules.name: The Two Working Colors Rule
rules.body: Pine and blaze are the only chromatic colors that do work. Blaze marks the one primary action in view and the thing you must not miss; pine marks wayfinding, secondary actions, and calm notices. There is no red anywhere, including errors.

rules.name: The Cream Letters Rule
rules.body: Text on any board surface (header, footer, hero board, plank, action bar) is cream, never white, never ink. Routed text carries the up-and-down text shadow (`0 -1px 0 rgba(0,0,0,0.55), 0 1px 0 rgba(255,245,220,0.18)`) so it reads as cut into the wood.

rules.name: The One Board Rule
rules.body: A page has one routed board in its main content: the hero sign on Home, the single board on the thank-you and 404 pages, or none on the reading pages. Header, footer, and the phone action bar are the kiosk frame, not additional boards.

rules.name: The 18px Floor Rule
rules.body: `html { font-size: 18px }` and no rule sets text below 1rem. The floor is a fact of the stylesheet, not a target.

rules.name: The No Eyebrow Rule
rules.body: Labels are never uppercased or letter-spaced. Section context comes from the plank heading and the lede paragraph beneath it, never from a small tracked caps line above.

rules.name: The Balanced Heading Rule
rules.body: All headings use `text-wrap: balance` and negative tracking (-0.01em); the display date tightens to -0.03em.

rules.name: The Plaque Lift Rule
rules.body: Plaques are the only interactive element that lifts and presses. Chips scale down (0.96) on press but never cast a shadow; nav links and choice rows change fill only.

rules.name: The Planks Sit Flush Rule
rules.body: A plank heading is framed by inset lines and never carries a drop shadow. If a heading appears to float, it is wrong.

dos: **Do** keep the root at 18px and never set text below 1rem; `small` and `.fine` are the floor.
**Do** give every tappable thing at least 44px: plaques 3.25rem, chips and compact plaques 2.9rem, nav links 3rem, FAQ summaries 3.5rem, footer links 2.75rem, lodging name links 2.6rem.
**Do** put one routed board in a page's main content at most, and put the when-and-where facts on it.
**Do** use blaze for exactly one primary plaque per view and pine for the secondary; every other plaque is cream.
**Do** keep text on board surfaces cream, with the routed text shadow on Rubik headings.
**Do** frame planks with inset lines only, and let plaques be the only element with a base and a cast shadow.
**Do** head every paper section with a plank (or a pine plank for wayfinding) followed by a plain lede in ink 2.
**Do** lay facts out as ruled key/value rows, and state a fact as unknown ("the family will update this") when it is unknown.
**Do** use inline stroke SVG icons (24-unit, 2 to 2.4 stroke, round caps) beside plaque text and in wayfinding; keep them `aria-hidden`.
**Do** gate every animation on `.js`, use `--ease` for all of it, and give each element one authored entrance.
**Do** keep every state change legible under reduced motion; remove travel, not information.
**Do** show a visible 3px blaze focus ring on paper and a cream ring on board surfaces.
donts: **Don't** use red anywhere; invalid fields and errors are blaze deep and blaze text.
**Don't** add eyebrows, kickers, or uppercase tracked labels above headings.
**Don't** use exclamation points, countdowns, urgency language, or alarm colors.
**Don't** put white text on the board or ink text on the board; it is cream or nothing.
**Don't** give planks, notices, chips, rows, or fields a drop shadow.
**Don't** introduce a second dark field in main content beside the board; reading happens on paper.
**Don't** use icon fonts, emoji, or raster icons; the only rasters are the ridge, the share card, and the touch icon.
**Don't** photograph the wood; the grain is the authored `grain.svg` wash.
**Don't** fabricate a photograph, quote, or fact; the portrait slot stays a dashed placeholder until the family supplies an image.
**Don't** set body prose wider than 66ch or ruled lists wider than 52rem (56rem for lodging).
**Don't** animate anything on a loop except the ridge leaves and mist, and stop those when the ridge is off screen.
